tasks.label: Floatee Release build
tasks.command: Get-Process Floatee -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; cmake --build "${workspaceFolder}\build_check" --config Release --target Floatee

tasks.label: Floatee run
tasks.command: Start-Process "${workspaceFolder}\build_check\Release\Floatee.exe"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; if (Get-Process Floatee -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output "running ok" } else { Write-Output "NOT RUNNING"; exit 1 }
